description: REQUIRES prior nps_edi__auth__npki_session__login call with same account_link_id. Get detailed pension notification document. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진 요청 처리 시 XBOSS 작업을 생성하고 처리 결과를 저장합니다. 기관 원본의 조회 여부와 별개로 이 호출은 순수 읽기 전용이 아닙니다. 기관 데이터 변경은 도구별 실행 내용과 기존 확인 절차를 따릅니다.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

mark_as_read.description: Mark as read on view (default true).

member_name.description: Member name for the detail member search.

member_resident_no.description: Member resident registration number for the detail member search.

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.

row_index.description: Row index from a prior search options[].row_index (search first, or same session right after search).

row_key.description: Row key from a prior search options[].row_key (e.g. wediDocNo).

search_type_code.description: Member search type code for the detail.

template_code.description: Template (document form) code. Search treats A / ALL / 전체 as all documents; detail supports ED33 only (others return UNSUPPORTED_PENSION_NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATE).
